description_en: Queries the list of domain names bound to a website
description_zh: 查询网站绑定域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun websitebuild list-app-instance-domains --biz-id WD20250718165839000001 --domain-keyword example-string --page-num 1 --page-size 0 --order-column CreationTime --order-type BUY --max-results 50 --next-token 0l45bkwM022Dt+rOvPi/oQ== --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppInstanceDomains

parameters.help_en: The domain name keyword. This parameter is optional and used for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 域名关键字（可选，用于模糊查询）
parameters.name: domain_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The domain management type. Valid values:

CUSTOM
PLATFORM_PREFIX

Default value: CUSTOM
parameters.help_zh: 域名管理类型：CUSTOM 或 PLATFORM_PREFIX；不传时默认查询 CUSTOM
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en:
The domain status query mode. Valid values:

BASIC: returns only the persisted status.
REALTIME: refreshes the external service status.

Default value: REALTIME
parameters.help_zh: 域名状态查询模式：BASIC / REALTIME；BASIC 仅返回持久化状态，REALTIME 刷新外部服务状态，未传时默认为 REALTIME
parameters.name: status_query_mode

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results
parameters.name: order_column

parameters.help_en:
The sort type. Valid values:

ASC
DESC
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. This parameter is empty if no more results are available
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token。没有下一个查询时为空
parameters.name: next_token
